def saveSettings(self, groupName=None):
        """ Writes the registry items into the persistent settings store.
        """
        if groupName is None:
            groupName = self.groupName

        settings = Qt.QSettings("Bruker", groupName)
        settings.setValue("width", self.width())
        settings.setValue("height", self.height())
        settings.setValue("x", self.x())
        settings.setValue("y", self.y())
